Enum Class Hour

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<Hour>
parking.Hour
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<Hour>, Constable
public enum Hour extends Enum<Hour>
Enum class that defines the operating hours of the parking decks. The hours use a 24-hour time format; each code maps to an opening time and a closing time.

    • isWithin

      public boolean isWithin(Timestamp timestamp)
      Check if the time of a timestamp is within the operating hours. The opening and closing times are both included.
      Parameters:
      timestamp - the timestamp to check.
